시편-92-1.title: 시편 92장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-92-1.exegesis: 14-16. God Himself speaks (compare Psa 46:10 ; 75:2 , 3 ). All the terms to express safety and peace indicate the most undoubting confidence (compare Psa 18:2 ; 20:1 ; 22:5 ). set his love-- that of the most ardent kind.

시편-92-2.title: 시편 92장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-92-2.exegesis: PSALM 92 Psa 92:1-15 . A Psalm-song--(see on Psa 30:1 , title). The theme: God should be praised for His righteous judgments on the wicked and His care and defense of His people. Such a topic, at all times proper, is specially so for the reflections of the Sabbath day. 1. sing ... name-- celebrate Thy perfections.

시편-92-3.title: 시편 92장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-92-3.exegesis: 2. in the morning, ... every night-- diligently and constantly ( Psa 42:8 ). loving kindness-- literally, "mercy." faithfulness-- in fulfilling promises ( Psa 89:14 ).
시편-92-3.theologicalNote: 2. in the morning, ... every night-- diligently and constantly ( Psa 42:8 ). loving kindness-- literally, "mercy." faithfulness-- in fulfilling promises ( Psa 89:14 ).

시편-92-4.title: 시편 92장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-92-4.exegesis: 3. In such a work all proper aid must be used. with a ... sound-- or, on Higgaion (see on Psa 9:16 ), perhaps an instrument of that name, from its sound resembling the muttered sound of meditation, as expressed also by the word. This is joined with the harp.

시편-92-5.title: 시편 92장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-92-5.exegesis: 4. thy work-- that is, of providence ( Psa 90:16 , 17 ).
시편-92-5.theologicalNote: 4. thy work-- that is, of providence ( Psa 90:16 , 17 ).

시편-92-6.title: 시편 92장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-92-6.exegesis: 5. great ... works-- correspond to deep or vast thoughts ( Psa 40:5 ; Ro 11:23 ).
시편-92-6.theologicalNote: 5. great ... works-- correspond to deep or vast thoughts ( Psa 40:5 ; Ro 11:23 ).

시편-92-7.title: 시편 92장 7절 역사문법적 주해
시편-92-7.exegesis: 6. A brutish man knoweth not-- that is, God's works, so the Psalmist describes himself ( Psa 73:22 ) when amazed by the prosperity of the wicked, now understood and explained.
